5381b6e4cd.a: Tarlov receives a rundown every morning at 11 a.m., giving her six hours to prepare. She notes that lots of liberals and moderates work there, and she has many friends at the network. She highlights that Fox offers well compensation, great healthcare, and strong maternity and paternity leave benefits. She also mentions that the hair and makeup staff are particularly friendly and that the network implemented a vaccine mandate like most other places.

074f732900.q: What unexpected advice did Roger Ailes give about developing a distinctive on-air presence?
